scope: instruction-following non-linear video editing, adjacent generative-edit evaluation, and agent-evaluation infrastructure
notes: Release status is time-sensitive and must be rechecked before taking a dependency.
The entries classify what each work evaluates; shared words such as video editing do not imply equivalent tasks.
No public acronym is proposed for the Clash benchmark in this research record.

works.title: MEDit-Bench: A Dataset for Evaluating Message-Driven Narrative Video Editing
works.input: long-form source video and natural-language narrative message
works.output: ordered temporal cuts for a 1-3 minute cut-only edit
works.oracle: three professional edits per video-message pair; temporal recall, cut F1, mIoU, human preference
works.relevance: closest precedent for natural-language narrative briefs, multiple valid references, and programmatic temporal scoring

works.title: EditDuet: A Multi-Agent System for Video Non-Linear Editing
works.input: user request, A-roll, transcript, and a searchable B-roll collection
works.output: mutated NLE timeline and rendered video
works.oracle: failure rate, duration coverage, repeated footage, pairwise VLM judge, and a 35-person human study
works.relevance: closest published agent and tool environment for actual NLE

works.title: ELLMPEG: An Edge-based Agentic LLM Video Processing Tool
works.input: natural-language FFmpeg or VVenC request
works.oracle: command accuracy, validity, runtime correctness, throughput, latency, and energy
works.relevance: direct FFmpeg agent baseline over 480 queries

works.title: GLANCE: A Global-Local Coordination Multi-Agent Framework for Music-Grounded Non-Linear Video Editing
works.input: music, footage, and an editing prompt
works.oracle: agent judge over rhythm, emotion, instruction following, story completeness, continuity, and quality
works.relevance: music-editing taxonomy and task difficulty axes
works.releaseNote: official repository said code will be released soon on 2026-08-14

works.title: VideoAgent: All-in-One Framework for Video Understanding and Editing
works.input: high-level multimodal editing or remaking request
works.oracle: workflow success, retrieval ordering/IoU/alignment, and human ratings
works.relevance: broad operation taxonomy and complex orchestration baseline

works.title: Crayotter: Traceable Multi-Agent Workflows for Long-Form Video Editing
works.input: one natural-language long-form production request and heterogeneous media
works.output: artifacts, timeline execution, intermediate renders, and final video
works.oracle: human evaluation over 23 themes
works.relevance: strong precedent for first-class traces, artifacts, checkpoints, and recovery

works.title: VideoAdAgent Bench v1
works.input: structured fictional-brand advertising brief and reference assets
works.oracle: position-swapped pairwise judges, deterministic duration/aspect/audio/OCR checks, defect judge, cost, and latency
works.relevance: pre-registered detailed briefs plus deterministic production checks
works.caveat: vendor-authored and led by the evaluated product; not independent validation

works.title: VEBench: Benchmarking Large Multimodal Models for Real-World Video Editing
works.input: edited video for technique QA, or one reference clip plus candidate videos for operation-simulation QA
works.output: editing-technique answer, or candidate index plus temporal segment and placement
works.oracle: multiple-choice accuracy and candidate-conditional temporal IoU
works.relevance: editing-technique taxonomy, multi-video footage choice, and temporal localization
works.releaseNote: paper-linked project page returned HTTP 404 on 2026-08-14

works.title: VE-Bench: Subjective-Aligned Benchmark Suite for Text-Driven Video Editing Quality Assessment
works.input: instruction, source video, and generatively edited video
works.oracle: human MOS from 24 participants and a trained QA model
works.relevance: released human-aligned evaluator baseline

works.title: VEBench: Towards Comprehensive and Automatic Evaluation for Text-guided Video Editing
works.input: source, edit instruction, and edited output
works.oracle: human ratings for textual faithfulness, frame consistency, and video fidelity
works.relevance: meta-evaluation protocol for editing metrics and VEScore proposal
works.releaseNote: reviewed OpenReview version said code and data would be released upon acceptance

works.title: IVEBench: Modern Benchmark Suite for Instruction-Guided Video Editing Assessment
works.input: source video and instruction
works.oracle: traditional and MLLM metrics for video quality, instruction compliance, and video fidelity
works.relevance: broad task taxonomy and three-dimensional assessment

works.title: VEFX-Bench: A Holistic Benchmark for Generic Video Editing and Visual Effects
works.input: instruction, original video, and edited video
works.output: instruction following, render quality, and edit exclusivity scores
works.oracle: 5,049 annotated examples and released 4B/32B reward models
works.relevance: best released external evaluator baseline reviewed; edit-exclusivity dimension maps to preservation

works.title: TDVE-Assessor: Benchmarking and Evaluating the Quality of Text-Driven Video Editing with LMMs
works.input: source video, edit instruction, and edited video
works.oracle: 3,857 edited videos and 173,565 human ratings
works.relevance: large human-rating corpus and secondary evaluator baseline

works.title: FiVE-Bench: A Fine-grained Video Editing Benchmark for Evaluating Emerging Diffusion and Rectified Flow Models
works.input: source video, object-level instruction, and masks
works.oracle: 15 metrics covering preservation, alignment, consistency, quality, and VLM-based edit success
works.relevance: fine-grained object-level edit and preservation taxonomy

works.title: CoVEBench: Can Video Editing Models Handle Complex Instructions?
works.input: source video and compositional multi-point editing instruction
works.oracle: 9,990 fine-grained checklist items plus MLLM and automatic metrics
works.relevance: per-requirement checklist scoring and preservation failures under compositional requests

works.title: OmniEdit-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Instruction-based Video Editing
works.input: source video, instruction, and optional reference image/video
works.oracle: Gemini rubric for accuracy, preservation, realism, and consistency with an accuracy-aware penalty
works.relevance: spatial/temporal/reasoning/audio/reference taxonomy and accuracy-gated quality aggregation

works.title: Aurora: Unified Video Editing with a Tool-Using Agent
works.input: instruction plus optional tool-retrieved reference
works.oracle: multi-axis VLM rubric over retrieval-conditioned and reasoning edits
works.relevance: agent path and retrieval-conditioned generative edits
works.releaseNote: AgentEdit-Bench data was still marked TODO on 2026-08-14

works.title: VEU-Bench: Towards Comprehensive Understanding of Video Editing
works.input: edited video and recognition/reasoning/judging question
works.oracle: 19 fine-grained tasks across recognition, reasoning, and judging
works.relevance: editing-technique and cinematography taxonomy

works.title: GUIDE: A Benchmark for Understanding and Assisting Users in Open-Ended GUI Tasks
works.input: screen recording and user context from open-ended application use
works.output: behavior state, intent, and help prediction
works.oracle: 67.5 hours from 120 novice demonstrations across 10 applications
works.relevance: human Premiere Pro and CapCut workflow and assistance taxonomy

works.title: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
works.input: natural-language task and initialized real desktop environment
works.oracle: execution-based postcondition scripts
works.relevance: environment reset, task execution, postcondition evaluation, trajectories, and verified public runs

works.title: SWE-bench Verified
works.input: real GitHub issue and repository
works.oracle: human-validated issue/test quality and containerized executable tests
works.relevance: analogy for brief verification, hidden edit-to-pass and pass-to-pass checks, and reproducible execution
